name: awesome-mcp-servers
one_liner: A big curated list of MCP servers — plugins that let AI assistants connect to other tools and services.
buyer: No real buyer — this is a free reference list for developers, not a product.
business_use_cases: A developer browses it to find an existing MCP server instead of building one from scratch.
A tooling vendor checks it to see what integrations already exist before building their own.
A newcomer to MCP uses it as a map of the ecosystem.

money_ideas.idea: The list itself could sell sponsored/featured placements to MCP server vendors, the way other "awesome lists" and directories do.

steal_this: Honestly, this is a reference list, not a business. Its only realistic revenue path is sponsored placements, and even that's a thin margin play.
